lines.text: Paul proposes revisiting the brothers in every town where they preached, but refuses to take Mark, who deserted them.
After a sharp disagreement, Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Crete, while Paul chose Silas and strengthened churches.
In Lystra, Paul found the disciple Timothy and circumcised him because the Jews there knew his father was Greek.
The Spirit of Jesus would not let them enter Galatia, so they passed Mysia and went to Troas.
Paul saw a night vision of a man of Macedonia pleading for help, and they concluded God had called them.
